paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.16 as of the last update, with a change of -15.05% from the prior close and -33.33% over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include discussions about Project Matador funding worries and their impact on AI power names, as well as the formalization of a credit support agreement between AMD and Fermi Inc. for the first phase of Project Matador.

There have been various SEC filings, including 2 Form 144 filings and 1 Form 8-K filing, which disclosed additional information about Fermi Inc.'s lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site. Insider filings include notices of proposed sales of restricted shares.
